title: Refuse to open a backlog written by a newer tadu format than the binary knows
notes: An old tadu should stop with an actionable message instead of misreading newer files.
done_when: an older binary exits with a clear error on a newer format and a test covers it
result: Refuse to open a backlog written by a newer tadu format than the binary knows
evidence: is_task_backlog refuses a todo/tadu.json declaring a format above 2 (NewerFormatError); cli main prints 'tadu: ... upgrade tadu' and exits 2, the hook exits 0; tests/test_newer_format.py covers list, doctor, add and the hook; gate passed, doctor clean
